domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUR8Nu4M7tbtgES7q2

Re-routed to `domain:server` · 2026-11-05T14:21Z · ⛔ not a claim. The storage half has no ui-only fix.

Read on `origin/main` `fa9c0aa2a0`:
- The 测试连接 toast prints the settings action's own `message`. `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts:910` returns `message: \`Storage round-trip succeeded (adapter=${adapter}).\`` (and the English failure sentences above it).
- `SettingsActionResultSchema` (`packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts:826`) carries `ok`, `message`, `severity` and an untyped `details`, with no message key or params. So the console can only print the server's sentence or match its English text, and the ui lane does not match English text.
- The fix is the server's: either the action answers in the request's language, or the action result gains a key the console can translate (a spec change, `domain:spec` first). Which of the two is the server lane's call; the console change that follows, if any, goes back to `domain:ui` as its own card.

The datasource half landed in PR #30442 (Landed 6658133994); its server follow-up is #30444.
